data.name: AION Color Pro digital-to-RGB monitor controller

introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

specification.conversion: Logix 4-bit index -> 16 x 12-bit palette -> three 4-bit DAC channels -> RGB voltage amplifiers. DAC ladders, analog drivers, HV/deflection remain explicit board components; their integration on silicon is not assumed.
specification.bandwidth: 25–30 MHz RGB amplifier design target; verify DAC settling, text focus, convergence and line-boundary palette commits.
